remarks: Located at the heart of Holiday Valley Resort, this Fourth floor One bedroom deluxe layout that accommodates up 8 people if using the full unit. The lockout option gives you the chance to use both sides, or just use half and rent the other half. Fractional ownership gives you 10-11 rotating weeks per year with options for additional usage based on occupancy. Ownership amenities include discounts on lift tickets, golf, private owner locker rooms, private owner's lounge, underground parking while lodging overnight, valet parking, and year 'round access to the heated indoor/outdoor pool, hot tubs, sauna and fitness center.
